Solutions by Product Line

PET Cold Cup Solutions

Clear PET cups for cold beverages, with matched lids available across the core caliber range.

  • 74 / 78 / 90 / 93 / 95 / 98 / 107 mm options
  • 3 oz to 32 oz capacity range
  • Straight-wall, U-shape and dessert formats
  • Matching flat, dome and sipper lids

Applications: Bubble tea · Iced coffee · Smoothies · Desserts

Get Pricing

Injection PP Cup Solutions

Hard injection-molded PP cups in round, U-shape and square formats for hot and cold drinks.

  • 90 / 92 square / 95 mm caliber options
  • 360 ml to 960 ml capacity range
  • Clear and frosted finishes
  • Compatible with standard sealing machines

Applications: Milk tea chains · Fresh juice · Yogurt drinks

Get Pricing

Lids, Films & Accessories

Match lid type and sealing film to the selected cup rim before ordering.

  • Flat, dome, sipper and specialty lid types
  • PET and PP sealing film options
  • Straws, carriers and sleeves available
  • 90 / 92 / 95 / 98 / 119 mm matching options

Applications: Takeaway · Delivery platforms · Sealing machines
